title: Model Directory
description: Override the models base directory. Leave empty to use the default data folder (<data>/ginfer/models).

title: ginfer-serve Binary
description: Path to the ginfer-serve executable. Leave empty to use the default location (<data>/ginfer/bin/ginfer-serve).

title: Vision
description: Launch the server with --vision so image inputs are accepted. Startup-only: requires a reload to change.

title: Speculative Decoding
description: Draft backend: auto, none, mtp, or dflash. Startup-only.

title: Draft Tokens
description: Number of speculative draft tokens (--draft-tokens). 0 leaves the server default.

title: KV Cache Dtype
description: KV cache storage: bf16 or int8. Empty leaves the server default. Startup-only.

title: LM Head Draft
description: Use the LM head for drafting (--lm-head-draft). Startup-only.

title: Max Context
description: Maximum context window (--max-context). 0 leaves the server default (2048).

title: KV Capacity
description: Shared KV capacity (--kv-capacity). A number or 'auto'. Empty follows max-context.

title: Prefill Chunk
description: Prefill chunk size (--prefill-chunk). Must be a multiple of 128. 0 leaves the server default.

title: Max Concurrency
description: Maximum concurrent generations (--max-concurrency, 1-8). 0 leaves the server default.

title: Auto Unload
description: Unload any other loaded GInfer model before loading a new one.
